newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan gunmen shoot dead Swedish tour guide.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan gunmen shoot dead Swedish tour guide.

text.p: Police said on Saturday they were hunting for two gunmen who ambushed and shot dead a Swedish tour guide on Kenya's Indian Ocean coast in a failed robbery.
Malindi police chief Peter Nzoika said Jenny Forsberg was shot at point blank range by two gunmen as she was being driven by a Finnish friend on a road north of Mombasa on Thursday.
The Finnish friend, who was not identified, was not harmed and managed to drive to a hotel where she raised the alarm.
A spokesman for the Swedish embassy in Nairobi said it had been notified of the killing and had told Forsberg's relatives.
Forsberg was killed amid a wave of robberies in the Mombasa area. Tourism is Kenya's largest source of foreign exchange but sporadic attacks on foreign tourists have slowed growth.
